caption: aya brea's overdose - body-hopping shooter mechanics wrapped in a time-collapsed new york.
about: The 3rd birthday (2010) is the parasite eve spin-off that traded survival horror for third-person shooting with a twist: aya brea projects her soul into soldiers on the field, which doubles as the game's respawn, its puzzle tool and its narrative device. The time-collapsed manhattan setting gives the shooting a mood the series never revisited.
No windows build exists, so the platform is psp - played through ppsspp, rom sourced from romsfun.
